title: Vibe Coding: AI-Assisted Software Engineering
description: A 500-card masterclass for building software with coding agents responsibly: problem framing, specifications, prompting, context engineering, architecture, product and UI design, backend and data engineering, security, testing, debugging, Git and review, dependencies, performance, accessibility, reproducible environments, CI/CD, observability, agent tools, failure recovery, refactoring, and production readiness.

paths.title: Vibe Coding Foundations
paths.description: Understand what vibe coding is, where it helps, where it fails, and the engineering mindset that keeps speed from becoming fragility.

paths.title: Product Thinking & Problem Framing
paths.description: Turn vague ideas into user-centered problems, outcomes, constraints, and scope before asking an agent to build.

paths.title: Specifications & Acceptance Criteria
paths.description: Convert intent into precise, testable requirements that guide both AI implementation and human review.

paths.title: Prompting for Coding Agents
paths.description: Write prompts that provide intent, scope, context, constraints, evidence, and verification without micromanaging every token.

paths.title: Context Engineering & Repository Instructions
paths.description: Give agents the right persistent and task-specific context while avoiding noisy, stale, or unsafe instructions.

paths.title: Planning & Task Decomposition
paths.description: Break ambitious requests into ordered, independently verifiable slices that reduce agent drift and integration risk.

paths.title: Architecture & System Design
paths.description: Use AI without surrendering architectural coherence, boundaries, data ownership, and long-term changeability.

paths.title: Frontend, UI & UX Design
paths.description: Build AI-generated interfaces that are coherent, responsive, accessible, state-complete, and grounded in a design system.

paths.title: Backend & API Engineering
paths.description: Generate server-side code with explicit contracts, validation, authorization, idempotency, reliability, and operational behavior.

paths.title: Databases, Data Modeling & Migrations
paths.description: Design persistent data deliberately so AI-generated features preserve integrity, privacy, performance, and recoverability.

paths.title: Security, Privacy & Threat Modeling
paths.description: Apply secure design and current web-application risk controls to AI-generated software instead of treating security as a final scan.

paths.title: Testing Strategy & Verification
paths.description: Use layered automated and manual evidence to prove AI-generated behavior rather than trusting compilation or model confidence.

paths.title: Debugging & Root-Cause Analysis
paths.description: Diagnose defects with evidence, reproducibility, and causal reasoning instead of prompting the model to make random patches.

paths.title: Git, Commits & Pull Requests
paths.description: Keep AI-assisted work reviewable, attributable, reversible, and safely integrated through disciplined version-control practices.

paths.title: Code Review & AI Review
paths.description: Review generated changes for behavior, architecture, security, maintainability, and evidence rather than accepting plausible-looking code.

paths.title: Dependencies & Package Hygiene
paths.description: Choose, verify, update, and remove third-party packages safely when coding agents can suggest libraries faster than humans can assess them.

paths.title: Performance & Scalability
paths.description: Keep AI-generated software responsive and efficient by measuring bottlenecks, setting budgets, and optimizing the right layer.

paths.title: Accessibility & Internationalization
paths.description: Ensure generated products work for diverse users, input methods, languages, locales, and content lengths.

paths.title: Development Environments, Docker & Reproducibility
paths.description: Make AI-assisted changes reproducible across machines through explicit environments, containers, configuration, and setup automation.

paths.title: CI/CD, Deployment & Release Engineering
paths.description: Turn fast AI-generated changes into controlled, repeatable releases with gated validation, immutable artifacts, migrations, and rollback.

paths.title: Observability, Reliability & Operations
paths.description: Design AI-generated services so operators can detect, explain, and recover from failures after deployment.

paths.title: Agentic Workflows, Tools & MCP
paths.description: Coordinate coding agents, shell tools, browsers, repositories, databases, and external integrations without losing scope, trust, or evidence.

paths.title: AI Failure Modes, Hallucinations & Recovery
paths.description: Recognize characteristic coding-agent errors early and use workflows that recover without compounding bad assumptions.

paths.title: Refactoring, Legacy Code & Migrations
paths.description: Use AI to improve existing systems without erasing undocumented behavior, breaking compatibility, or mixing cleanup with feature risk.

paths.title: Production Readiness, Governance & Team Practice
paths.description: Define the final quality gate for AI-assisted software: ownership, security, reliability, documentation, operations, and continuous improvement.
